# SNYPD

> Public Vinted search monitoring and alerts for new matching listings.

SNYPD is independent of Vinted. It does not log into Vinted accounts, buy items,
message sellers, or monitor price drops on existing listings.
This optional navigation summary is not an access policy or a promise of search inclusion.

## Public sources

- [Product](https://www.snypd.store/)
- [Current plans and billing](https://www.snypd.store/plans)
- [Price-guide method](https://www.snypd.store/vinted-price-guide#method)
- [Price checker](https://www.snypd.store/vinted-price-checker)
- [Monthly reports and source data](https://www.snypd.store/vinted-market-report)
- [Italian checker](https://www.snypd.store/it/stima-prezzo-vinted)
- [Italian guide pilot](https://www.snypd.store/it/prezzi-vinted)
- [Support](https://www.snypd.store/support)

## Pricing

- Free: EUR 0, free.
- Solo: EUR 5.99, per month.
- Kickstart: EUR 14.99, per month.
- Pro: EUR 24.99, per month.
- Elite: EUR 34.99, per month.
- Hunt Pass: EUR 3.99, one-time payment; 30 days; no renewal.

Free includes one search, with 24/7 monitoring for the first three days after saving
the first search; afterwards it runs while the dashboard is open. Consult /plans
for current limits and billing details.

## Price data

Observation window: 2026-10-18 to 2026-11-01. Marketplace: vinted.be. Currency: EUR.
34 overall estimates pass the publication checks; 4 existing item guides explain
why an overall estimate is withheld and show validated condition data where available.
These are asking prices, not completed-sale prices. The sample follows searches
SNYPD users monitor and is not representative of every marketplace or seller location.
Sample sizes for different item searches can overlap. Read the visible methodology.

## Reusable report downloads

- October 2026: https://www.snypd.store/vinted-market-report-2026-10.csv ; metadata: https://www.snypd.store/vinted-market-report-2026-10.metadata.json
- November 2026: https://www.snypd.store/vinted-market-report-2026-11.csv ; metadata: https://www.snypd.store/vinted-market-report-2026-11.metadata.json

The metadata supplies observation dates, source, licence, row count and checksum.
The report datasets are CC BY 4.0 with attribution to the dated report.
Country-language translations do not turn vinted.be samples into national price estimates.
